Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `StringUtil_ESTest.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/baseline/jsoup/_evosuite_raw/org/jsoup/internal/StringUtil_ESTest.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

I'll read both the original test and the CUT source to understand what needs to be improved.Now I have a clear picture of the original test and the CUT. I'll write an improved version with descriptive names, named constants for magic numbers, and clear variable names.Now I'll run the compile check.The improved test compiled successfully. The refactored `StringUtil_ESTest.java` replaces cryptic EvoSuite-generated names (`test00`, `boolean0`, `uRL0`, etc.) with descriptive method names, named variables, and comments explaining non-obvious values like magic code points (e.g., `173` → `// 173 is U+00AD (soft hyphen)`) and subtle edge cases (e.g., why a null `StringBuilder` doesn't throw when all input is whitespace with `stripLeading=true`).
